title: No successor in Ensembl's history: the answer is a bridge elsewhere
what: an id whose history ends (retired without successor, or asked before its birth) is answered with genes at another place, reached through names or external ids
rule: idtrack's bridges (rule `external_bridge`); the decided rule `bridge_same_place` restricts them by place
user_action: check `ExplainedPath` for external steps; treat answers with bridges as candidates
measured_by: astar: wrong and undetermined answers of families/astar/runs/d4c2dda/sus_scrofa

title: Places across an assembly handoff that no chain maps cannot be compared
what: for an id without successor asked across an assembly handoff, a bridged answer is neither right nor wrong when no chain maps the place: no chain file at all (pig Sscrofa10.2/11.1, rhesus MMUL_1/Mmul_8/Mmul_10, cynomolgus 5.0/6.0), or the place's sequence is absent from the chain or under half of it aligns (human, mouse)
rule: Ensembl publishes no chain file for these handoffs; chains leave some sequences out
user_action: read the answer's place yourself (e.g. by liftover with an external alignment)
measured_by: astar: wrong and undetermined answers of families/astar/runs/d4c2dda/sus_scrofa
